const cy=document.querySelector('#cy')._cyreg.cy; const f=cy.nodes('.frame'); const pos=cy.nodes().map(n=>Math.round(n.position('x'))+','+Math.round(n.position('y'))).join(' '); if(!f.length) return 'no frame | '+pos; const b=f.boundingBox(); const inF=cy.nodes('.stub').filter(s=>{const p=s.boundingBox(); return p.x1<b.x2&&p.x2>b.x1&&p.y1<b.y2&&p.y2>b.y1}).map(s=>s.id()); const st=cy.nodes('.stub').map(s=>s.boundingBox()); let ov=0; for(let i=0;i<st.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<st.length;j++){const p=st[i],q=st[j]; if(p.x1<q.x2&&p.x2>q.x1&&p.y1<q.y2&&p.y2>q.y1) ov++} return 'frame '+f.data('label')+', children '+f.children().length+', stubs overlapping frame: ['+inF+'], stub pairs overlapping: '+ov+' | '+pos
